title: ACT rental standards: insulation, smoke alarms and repairs
description: Steps to meet the ACT ceiling insulation minimum standard and other safety basics before and during a tenancy. Summarised from act.gov.au and ACT Emergency Services Agency pages.

sources.title: Minimum housing standard for ceiling insulation in rental properties

items.title: Check the ceiling insulation R-value
items.detail: Below R2 or none means you must top up to at least R5.

items.title: Check whether an exemption applies, and keep evidence
Have a licensed electrician do an electrical safety inspection before insulation work
Finish by 30 November 2026 (existing tenancies) or within 9 months of a new agreement
Keep the receipt showing the R-value, the installer's report or statutory declarations
Disclose compliance or exemption in ads and the agreement
Make sure smoke alarms comply with AS 3786 and work at the start of the tenancy
Fix known repairs before move-in; non-urgent repairs during a tenancy within 4 weeks
Keep pool gates and covers closed and plan for a compliance certificate before 1 May 2028
